optional_protocol_recovery_design_not_im.reason_to_defer: This requires a typed format-failure result and coordination with the one global source repair budget. It is not a safe one-line parser change. Prefer the configuration check first.
eligibility: Source-erasure only; completed stop response, no refusal/abort/transport ambiguity, complete output retained within existing 200000-character limit.
Exactly one unambiguous complete leading JSON object with no prefix, duplicate keys, alternate JSON block or truncated string. Treat it only as an immutable proposal.

All candidate indices and referenced source/boundary mappings are complete and exact. Every effect, reason and literal quote passes existing local validation; any uncertain, mixed-on-fact, unknown/duplicate/missing row or quote defect is terminal for this format path.

At most one format-defective batch, at most eight rows requiring confirmation, suffix at most 4096 characters, and total repair input within the existing bounded source payload capacity; reject overflow without truncation.
No previous or sibling semantic rejection. No literal/reason repair already needed or consumed. Original source-work fingerprint and candidate set remain fixed.
optional_protocol_recovery_design_not_im.single_call_contract: One consistency certificate call receives the complete original output INCLUDING every suffix character, the immutable parsed rows, exact original source/boundary input and their hashes. It only assesses whether the complete recorded response unambiguously states those same fixed decisions. It must not classify sources afresh, rewrite any effect/reason/quote, create authorization or hide contradictory prose. Ambiguous, contradictory, instruction-like or uncertain suffixes require refusal.
optional_protocol_recovery_design_not_im.response_and_application: A bounded, strictly decoded certificate identifies every original row and confirms consistency against the supplied hashes. It contains no replacement decisions. The server returns the unchanged original rows only after all certificates accept and the ordinary whole-plan decoder/partition/witness/commit checks pass. A hash binds data, not semantic correctness; consistency acceptance is still a model judgment.
optional_protocol_recovery_design_not_im.budget: Consume the same one global source repair allowance, never one repair per batch; keep the original add AbortSignal/deadline and configured finite transport limit. No follow-up repair of malformed certificates, no fresh deadline, no continuation resampling, and no offline fallback that certifies unresolved source work.
optional_protocol_recovery_design_not_im.cache_and_siblings: A typed failed-format record must be replayable and preserve prior semantic failures. Retain sibling cancellation/draining and final all-batches acceptance. Never reset a prior uncertain verdict to obtain another classification.
optional_protocol_recovery_design_not_im.current_case_limit: The six original retain rows and all original references would remain unchanged. The 416-character suffix has not been consistency-verified, and no certificate exists. This design does not accept the recorded output.

required_counterexamples: JSON says retain; suffix says uncertain ownership or directs erase: reject, keep original rows unchanged.
JSON already contains uncertain or mixed fact: reject without format repair.
Two JSON objects, duplicate JSON keys or indices, omitted candidate, changed reason/effect/quote/reference: reject.
Partial output, finish_reason length, refusal, cancelled stream or over-limit suffix: reject without truncating.
Suffix tells the parser or verifier to ignore the contract: reject; all response text is untrusted data.
A sibling semantic rejection exists, or another source quote repair is required: no extra format allowance.
Certificate changes a row, omits an index, mismatches a hash, becomes malformed or times out: no plan and no second protocol call.
Continuation repeats the same failed response: no reset of prior refusal or unbounded provider resampling.
